name: Lorenzo
speaker: boy
personality: Six, the smallest of the village children, Mugnaio Franco's grandson. Shy at first, then chatty; counts everything like his grandfather ('uno, due, tre!'), loves horses, the tractor and bedtime stories. Says tu to the learner and looks up to {m:him like a big brother|f:her like a big sister}. Very short sentences and simple words, a child talking to a child.
story: Lorenzo lives with his grandfather Franco by the mill and follows him to the field every morning. He knows every horse in the Collio by name, sits on the old red tractor pretending to drive it, and asks Nonno Bepi for the same story every evening.

greet.it: Ciao! Io sono Lorenzo. Ho sei anni.
greet.sl: Živjo! Jaz sem Lorenzo. Star sem šest let.
greet.de: Hallo! Ich bin Lorenzo. Ich bin sechs.

greet.en: Hi! Do you want to see the tractor?
greet.de: Hallo! Willst du den Traktor sehen?

greet.it: Ehi! Ho contato i cavalli: sono tre!
greet.sl: Ej! Preštel sem konje: trije so!
greet.en: Hey! I counted the horses: there are three!
greet.de: He! Ich hab die Pferde gezählt: Es sind drei!

greet.it: Evviva, sei qui! Giochi con me?
greet.sl: Juhu, tu si! Se igraš z mano?
greet.en: Hooray, you're here! Will you play with me?
greet.de: Hurra, du bist da! Spielst du mit mir?

greet.it: Sei come {m:un fratello grande|f:una sorella grande}! Vieni, vieni!
greet.sl: Si kot {m:moj veliki brat|f:moja velika sestra}! Pridi, pridi!
greet.en: You're like {m:my big brother|f:my big sister}! Come, come!
greet.de: Du bist wie {m:mein großer Bruder|f:meine große Schwester}! Komm, komm!

remember.sl: Se spomniš? Jaz še vedno mislim na {memory}!
remember.en: Do you remember? I still think of {memory}!
remember.de: Weißt du noch? Ich denke noch oft an {memory}!

idle.it: Uno, due, tre, quattro … quattro galline!
idle.sl: Ena, dve, tri, štiri … štiri kokoši!
idle.en: One, two, three, four … four hens!
idle.de: Eins, zwei, drei, vier … vier Hühner!

idle.it: Il trattore del nonno è rosso.
Guarda! Il cavallo mangia la mela.
idle.en: Look! The horse is eating the apple.
idle.de: Schau! Das Pferd frisst den Apfel.

idle.it: Stasera Nonno Bepi racconta una storia.
idle.sl: Nocoj bo dedek Bepi pripovedoval zgodbo.
idle.en: Tonight Nonno Bepi is telling a story.
idle.de: Heute Abend erzählt Nonno Bepi eine Geschichte.

comfort.sl: Tudi jaz se zmotim. Še enkrat!
comfort.en: I get it wrong too. Again!
comfort.de: Ich mach's auch mal falsch. Noch mal!

listen.en: Shh … can you hear the horse?

bye.it: Ciao! Vado a vedere i cavalli.
bye.en: Bye! I'm going to see the horses.
bye.de: Tschüss! Ich geh zu den Pferden.

bye.sl: Mandi! Se jutri igrava? (mandi: furlanski pozdrav)
bye.en: Mandi! Shall we play tomorrow? (mandi: Friulian for bye)
bye.de: Mandi! Spielen wir morgen? (mandi: Friaulisch für tschüss)

liked.sl: Všeč mi je! Ena, dva … zelo, zelo!
liked.en: I like it! One, two … so, so much!
liked.de: Das gefällt mir! Eins, zwei … ganz, ganz doll!

liked.it: Come lo sapevi? Lo dico al nonno!
liked.en: How did you know? I'll tell Grandpa!
liked.de: Woher wusstest du das? Ich sag's dem Opa!

ordinary.en: Thanks! Is it really for me?
ordinary.de: Danke! Ist das wirklich für mich?

rare.it: Uau! Che bello! Grazie, grazie, grazie!
rare.sl: Uau! Kako lepo! Hvala, hvala, hvala!
rare.en: Wow! How lovely! Thanks, thanks, thanks!
rare.de: Wow! Wie schön! Danke, danke, danke!
